name: thrown_fall
note: a heavy blow from the front: thrown off the feet, lands on the back, rolls to hands and knees and stands (its own get-up)

name: side_fall
note: knocked down from the side: buckles and goes down sideways (mirrored for the other side)

name: sweep_fall
note: legs taken out: the feet go up and the body lands flat on the back

name: hard_land
note: a high landing: knees absorb it into a crouch with a hand on the floor, then rise

name: getup2
note: the get-up from face down: push up onto the hands, a knee forward, stand into guard
